Checks a BECE candidate's CSSPS choices against the official rules (8 choices, boarding/day split, category limits, no repeats) and against what each school offers (programme, boarding, gender). `errors` break a rule; `warnings` are advice, such as a day school far from home. Returns 200 with `valid: false` for a form that breaks rules; 400 only for a malformed request.

info.description:
Ghana's education data: schools, the 2026 GES SHS placement register and CSSPS choice validation.

1. Get a free key at https://sukuudata.com/register
2. Set the collection variable `apiKey`
3. Send any request.

Quickstart: https://sukuudata.com/quickstart
